Records.description: The authors give all master integrals used in the computation of quark and gluon form factors to three loops in QCD. These integrals are available in Appendix A and all have a prefactor given by Eq. A.1.

Records.description: Three-loop NPL1 bare scalar (all unit propagator powers) imported from arXiv:2111.13595 ancillary i2m IBP reduction (sector 20721; 68 master(s)). One off-shell external leg P^2 = MM, the other external legs on-shell massless; single-scale (x-free, immune to the t/u variable choice). D=4-2eps all-unit-power scalar, leading 1/eps^3. Stored in the e^{+i pi} branch (library-native).
Records.verifiedVia: criterion-3: anc i2m bare-scalar value == library STIntegrate-native(home graph) EXACT (max|diff|=0) at 3 Euclidean points across delta-free orders eps^lead..0 (the stored truncation; not validated beyond eps^0). STIntegrate-native ran on the cluster (Nereid) via the HyperIntica backend (HyperFLINT dylib absent; the SubTropica backends integrate the same Symanzik integrand and cross-check); MZV ginsh-reduction on the Mac; additionally re-confirmed byte-identically against an independent all-Mac run. STVerify N/A (timelike e^{+i pi} branch-resolution gap, same as the existing symbol-proposal records in this entry).
